letter.title: Strange Lights
letter.body:
Something strange is going on in Brittleshin Pass. I saw flashes coming from the entrance last night. I didn't stay to find out what was causing them.

It's west of Riverwood, north of Lake Ilinalta. If you go in, be careful.

journal.title: Workshop Notes
journal.body:
The plans for both staves are finished. I've left them by the enchanting bench, next to the unfinished staff.

Take a plan to a forge and bring the listed materials. The unfinished staff will save some work, but there's only enough to finish one of them.

storm.title: Stormheart - Crafting Pattern
storm.body:
Stormheart

2 gold ingots
1 dragon bone
2 frost salts
1 filled grand soul gem

Use a forge. If you have the unfinished staff, you only need 1 gold ingot, 1 frost salt and the filled soul gem.

Keep this plan with you while you work.

cinder.title: Cinderfang - Crafting Pattern
cinder.body:
Cinderfang

2 silver ingots
1 dragon bone
2 fire salts
1 filled grand soul gem

Use a forge. If you have the unfinished staff, you only need 1 silver ingot, 1 fire salt and the filled soul gem.

Keep this plan with you while you work.

stages.10: A note at the Sleeping Giant Inn mentions strange lights at Brittleshin Pass. I should take a look.
stages.20: I found a workshop in the cave. There are plans for two staves and an unfinished staff nearby.
stages.100: I found the plans and the unfinished staff. I can finish a staff at a forge.

objectives.20: Collect both crafting plans and the unfinished staff
